steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Desert in Filter environments. Click Desert Sanctum, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Set the 2 fossils on the sand. Put Red Coral by the Coral Fossil and Eucidaris by the Sea Urchin Fossil. Add the Star Fish and Conch Shell nearby.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “The coral fossil is evidence that this desert was once ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add a Vertebrae Fossil (a backbone) and a fish beside it: Vertebrae Reef Fish

vr.full: Your photo shows both fossils, each with its living thing, plus the Star Fish and Conch Shell.

studio.title: Fossil cousins
studio.look: Each card shows a fossil. Below it are 4 living things from today. A cousin is a living thing from the same family as the fossil.
studio.do: Tap the living cousin, or drag the fossil onto it. Then tap where it lived.

frames.lead: 1. What was the Texas desert long ago?
frames.starter: I think this desert was once ___ because ___.

studio.full: You matched all 4 fossils and picked where each lived. Your 2 sentences have at least 20 words.

voice.brief: Welcome to the desert, crew. Today we film Scene 17, The Lost Sea. Build what lived here long ago, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your six models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Desert, and pick Desert Sanctum. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Set down the two fossil clues first. Put each living thing next to its fossil. Then tell me what the fossils show.
voice.extra: Got time? Add a backbone fossil and a fish beside it. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Match each fossil to its living cousin. Then tell me what you think.
